detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

In today's adventures of side-project fun, I spun up a Grafana docker container. I got tired of squinting at log files.

Now my Rust app has logs I can follow easily and query. I'll wrap some stuff around database query info and rest endpoint times too.

Importantly, this is part of my docker compose. Local development is as easy as running `docker compose up -d` and you get database, application, and telemetry. I'm a big fan of low friction local dev.

#programming #grafana #telemetry #coding
